themes_detail.label: Street Encampments Spike
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints in CD 206 surged to 7 this week, a 367% jump from the 1.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, signaling a rapid emergence of street homelessness in Belmont/East Tremont.
evidence: 7 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5-complaint weekly baseline (367% spike, z-score: 3.67)
This represents the most acute emergence among all tracked issues in the district this week
Aligns with community board's long-standing requests for expanded social services and non-teaching staff to address homelessness
reporting_angles: On-the-ground reporting: Where are encampments forming, and what services are lacking?
Interview unhoused residents and local nonprofits about triggers for this week's concentration

themes_detail.label: Illegal Vending Enforcement Activity
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints jumped to 6 this week, a 243% increase from the 1.8-complaint weekly average, suggesting either a crackdown or an uptick in unlicensed street vending in the district.
evidence: 6 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.8-complaint weekly baseline (243% spike, z-score: 3.27)
Peak complaint week in at least the past 8 weeks
No prior local news coverage or community board discussion of vendor issues, suggesting this is newly visible
reporting_angles: Has the city launched a targeted enforcement campaign in Belmont/East Tremont this week?
Interview street vendors and local merchants about enforcement patterns and economic impact

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints spiked to 90 two weeks ago, a 229% jump from the 27.4-complaint weekly average, and remain elevated—indicating either ongoing construction, late-night activity, or public gatherings straining neighborhood quality of life.
evidence: 90 street/sidewalk noise complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 27.4-complaint weekly baseline (229% spike, z-score: 3.97)
Concurrent with 7 non-emergency police matter complaints (229% spike, z-score: 3.58) same week, suggesting disorder or disturbance events
Residential noise (1,847 complaints over 90 days) already a top concern; this spike indicates acute deterioration
reporting_angles: Are specific venues, late-night establishments, or construction sites driving the noise spike?
Interview residents and local business owners about noise patterns and times of day

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Accumulation
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints reached 10 three weeks ago, a 900% spike from the 1.0-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 9.0)—the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset—suggesting potential public health or sanitation failure.
evidence: 10 dead animal complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 1.0-complaint weekly baseline (900% spike, z-score: 9.0—highest anomaly recorded)
Peak severity z-score across all tracked spikes suggests extraordinary concentration event
Concurrent with 3 root/sewer/sidewalk condition complaints same week (500% spike, z-score: 3.54), suggesting infrastructure or waste management breakdown
reporting_angles: Did a specific disease outbreak, vector control failure, or sanitation backlog cause the dead animal spike?
Investigate city response times and whether Sanitation Department resources were overwhelmed

themes_detail.label: Illegal Parking Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Illegal parking complaints reached 130 last week, a 75% increase from the 74.2-complaint weekly average, adding pressure to an already-strained streetscape in a district with 1,021 parking complaints over 90 days.
evidence: 130 illegal parking complaints last week vs. 74.2-complaint weekly baseline (75% spike, z-score: 3.6)
Parking already the third-highest complaint category district-wide (1,021 complaints over 90 days)
Sustained elevation suggests ongoing supply problem rather than one-time event
reporting_angles: Are recent rezonings (Sojourner Truth-Mapes, 4506 Park Avenue) attracting new residents without parking solutions?
Map hotspots: Which blocks are seeing the worst parking violations?
